author: b0died
body:
Alright guys, this was my last day on avicus because I just didn't want to force myself to play anymore and this was my 3rd favorite server [Hey, at least I'm honest] Anyways, I got banned for "DDoS threats" by Awesomerp. I will admit, he did try to convince me not to do it but I did it anyway because I spend too much time on avicus that I could be using for something else. I would like to apologize to all my friends I made in game and all those people that were fangirling me, especially you Awesomerp. I know you didn't want to ban me because you kept trying to tell me not to and you let me say bye. I'm sorry if you guys were my friends but we still got skype :P Bye everyone, this is my last day on the forums or maybe 2 days from now- when school starts. Peace Awesomerp, Acceqted, DaFrozenBlaze, Random_Nub, and Mabella.

Love,
Kodae
